Between any two distinct real numbers x<y there is a rational number q with x<q<y.
(x y : ℝ) (h : x < y) : ∃ q : ℚ, x < q ∧ (q : ℝ) < y
Every real number is strictly less than some natural number, viewed as a real number.
Every real x lies in a half-open interval [n,n+1) for some integer n.
exact ⟨Int.floor x, Int.floor_le x, Int.lt_floor_add_one x⟩
For real numbers a≤b and c≤d, a*d+b*c is at most a*c+b*d.
(a b c d : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) : a * d + b * c ≤ a * c + b * d
If a function maps a finite set s of natural numbers into a smaller finite set t, two distinct elements of s have the same image.
(s t : Finset ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) (h : t.card < s.card) (hm : ∀ x ∈ s, f x ∈ t) : ∃ x ∈ s, ∃ y ∈ s, x ≠ y ∧ f x = f y
Every natural number n at least two has a prime divisor.
(n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) : ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ p ∣ n
For natural m and n, gcd(m,n) equals gcd(n modulo m,m), including m=0 under totalized natural remainder.
(m n : ℕ) : Nat.gcd m n = Nat.gcd (n % m) m
